test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 26th July 2021)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank no. 10.
solution:
The correct answer is 'determined.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence "***He looked upon the fight against hydrophobia as a battle and he was ___(10)___ to win at any cost***'' is indicating how Pasteur stood against hydrophobia.
 
• The use of the word ''win'' in the sentence indicates **to get something by hard work, great effort, etc**.
 
• Therefore, the most appropriate word to be filled in the blank is 'determined'.
 
• The word 'determined' means **having firmly decided to do something or to succeed, even if it is difficult**. 
 
 
• Example:* The government is **determined **to tackle inflation*.

 
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is option 3.

Complete Sentence: *He looked upon the fight against hydrophobia as a battle and he was determined to win at any cost*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Let us explore the other options:

 
 
• 'Devised' means **to invent a new way of doing something**. (कुछ करने का नया तरीक़ा निकालना)
 
• 'Decided' means **clear; definite**. (स्‍पष्‍ट; निश्चित)
 
• 'Developed' means **of a good level or standard**. (विकसित, उन्‍नत)

 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

 
• दिया गया वाक्य "*He looked upon the fight against hydrophobia as a battle and he was ___(10)___ to win at any cost*'' यह दर्शाता है कि पाश्चर हाइड्रोफोबिया के खिलाफ कैसे खड़ा था।
 
• वाक्य में ''win'' शब्द का प्रयोग **कठिन परिश्रम, महान प्रयास आदि से कुछ पाने की ओर संकेत करता है**।
 
• इसलिए, रिक्त स्थान में भरने के लिए सबसे उपयुक्त शब्द 'determined' है।
 
• 'Determined' शब्द का अर्थ है **कठिन होने के बावजूद किसी काम में सफलता प्राप्त करने का संकल्प, कृतसंकल्‍प, दृढ़निश्‍चयी**।
 
 
• उदाहरण: *The government is determined to tackle inflation*.
 
 

अत: सही उत्तर विकल्प 3 है।

पूर्ण वाक्य: *He looked upon the fight against hydrophobia as a battle and he was **determined** to win at any cost*.
